question: A production service is missing required admin audit logs. Should we remediate now or request a time-limited exception?
scope: Acme billing-admin · prod-eu · privileged admin actions

alternatives.title: Remediate immediately
alternatives.tradeoff: Closes the intended gap after verification, but Inez must confirm feasible delivery and displaced billing work.

alternatives.title: Request a bounded deviation
alternatives.tradeoff: Needs scoped approval, effective safeguards and an expiry. A request alone gives no authority.

alternatives.title: Accept the ticket status
alternatives.tradeoff: Contradicted by the direct sink test. It leaves the required fields unverified.

challenge.title: Does “logs exist” mean the right actions are reviewable?
challenge.body: Event volume can look healthy while the acting identity is missing. Two records repeat the same gateway claim.
challenge.check: Test actor, action, target and time end to end, then inspect approval separately.

stages.label: Logging gap

advice.title: Test the safeguard. Keep approval separate.
advice.reason: The sink test contradicts the "covered" ticket. Remediation remains the target; a bounded interim arrangement is only an option if its coverage works and the right owner approves.
advice.condition: Inez must confirm delivery feasibility. The security owner must decide any deviation. The requested exception grants no authority.
advice.next: Inez: arrange an actor-level safeguard test and prepare the scoped request.
advice.support: The selected sources establish the gap, not effective compensation or approval.

stages.status: Gap observed · safeguard untested · request only

stages.label: Add safeguard test

advice.title: The safeguard works in the test. Approval is still missing.
advice.reason: The independent test supports the interim feed for prod-eu. Ask Jules to decide the bounded request while Inez keeps remediation moving.
advice.condition: The request remains unapproved. Daily review and delivery feasibility need accountable confirmation.
advice.next: Jules: review EX-19, its conditions and the expiry.
advice.support: A successful test answers effectiveness in its scope. It cannot authorise a deviation.

stages.change: TEST-SG-19 resolves the initial coverage doubt. It does not turn the request into approval.

stages.label: Add approval and review records

advice.title: Use the bounded arrangement. Keep the fix moving.
advice.reason: APR-19 supplies approval and REV-19 records the first daily check. The gap remains open while Inez delivers the app fix.
advice.condition: Valid only through 7 October at 18:00 UTC, for prod-eu, with feed delivery and daily review. Later compliance is unobserved.
advice.next: Inez: continue the daily checks and verify the app fix before expiry.
advice.support: The approval, test and review are separate records. This does not close the underlying logging issue.

stages.change: Attributed approval and a daily review now support the interim arrangement as of 30 September.
stages.status: Approved for scope · first review observed · issue open

stages.label: Try expiry without a fix

advice.title: The approval expired. Reassess the gap.
advice.reason: The prior arrangement cannot support continued deviation after its end date. Escalate the unresolved logging gap to Jules and Inez.
advice.condition: No renewed approval or verified remediation is supplied. Do not imply automatic renewal.
advice.next: Jules and Inez: decide the immediate treatment of the unresolved gap.
advice.support: The unchanged approval is historical evidence; its validity is no longer current.

stages.change: The assessment date crossed APR-19’s expiry. Historical approval remains inspectable.

stages.label: Try a stopped feed

advice.title: A required safeguard failed. Reopen the decision.
advice.reason: The feed stopped while the exception period was still open. Its date alone cannot sustain the conditional arrangement.
advice.condition: Restore and verify the feed or seek another explicitly authorised response. The gap remains unresolved.
advice.next: Inez and Jules: respond to failed delivery and reassess EX-19.
advice.support: The new failed probe changes the effective safeguard state; yesterday’s successful test is retained.

stages.change: The later failed delivery check defeats a condition of APR-19.

stages.label: Try expanded scope

advice.title: The new environment needs its own decision.
advice.reason: APR-19 is limited to prod-eu. Confirm prod-us coverage and treatment instead of extending the old approval by analogy.
advice.condition: No prod-us approval or demonstrated safeguard is supplied. prod-eu records do not establish prod-us coverage.
advice.next: Inez and Jules: scope the prod-us gap and its required response.
advice.support: This changes the subject scope, not the wording of the existing approval.

stages.change: A new environment lies outside the earlier approval.

sourceFamilies.question: What finding or review actually needs a decision?
sourceFamilies.limit: Workflow status is not verified treatment or approval.

sourceFamilies.question: Which immutable account belongs to which custodian?
sourceFamilies.limit: Names and employment do not establish permissions.
sourceFamilies.coverage: Not used: attributed approval is synthetic development material; no authenticated people integration.

sourceFamilies.question: What can the exact account or service do, including inherited grants?
sourceFamilies.limit: A role catalogue is not a test of effective rights.
sourceFamilies.coverage: Not used: no account entitlement decision.

sourceFamilies.question: What happened in the observed window and what coverage is missing?
sourceFamilies.limit: No observed event is not proof of no activity or no need.

sourceFamilies.question: Which change produced which artifact?
sourceFamilies.limit: A merge or component match is not production treatment.
sourceFamilies.coverage: Not used: proposed app fix has no build or delivery receipt. Missing outcome remains unresolved.

sourceFamilies.question: What ran, and what exact outcome was independently checked?
sourceFamilies.limit: Implementation does not establish effective treatment or authority.

sourceFamilies.question: What requirement, boundary, approval and validity apply?
sourceFamilies.limit: A request or runbook does not implement or authorise a safeguard.

sourceFamilies.question: Who owns the treatment and which dependencies remain?
sourceFamilies.limit: A done ticket does not prove verification or delivery authority.

sourceFamilies.question: Which earlier incident or review makes a check relevant?
sourceFamilies.limit: Past similarity does not predict the new outcome.

sourceFamilies.question: Which attributed work or delivery constraint affects the choice?
sourceFamilies.limit: A date or statement does not grant approval or make an obligation mandatory.
